number would only be noise when the answer is clear.
6. One tap on "Use this coffee" writes a `bags` record and opens the shot form. "Pick another match" opens the same
   list as a weak match.
7. A weak match (below 80, or two candidates within 5 points) skips the card. The sheet asks "Which one is it?",
   says what was read from the bag, and lists up to three candidates as rows, each with its score ("match 68") so
   the owner can see how close they are. Tapping a row picks it. "None of these: type the coffee" opens search; if
   nothing matches (a café bag, a roaster not in the registry), the bag is saved with free text, the same way
   `coffee_freetext` works today.
8. If the roast date couldn't be read, a date picker defaults to 7 days ago.

Two taps when the match is confident, three when it's weak. The bag becomes the "current bag" until another one is started or it's marked
finished.

### 2. Log a shot

1. Today shows the current bag and a "Pull again" button with the last recipe ("18.0 → 36.4 g · grind 11").
2. "Pull again" opens the shot form prefilled from the last shot of this bag (or of this coffee, if the bag is
   new): dose, yield, grind, water temp, grinder, basket, brew method, milk drink. Time is not prefilled: it starts
   as "Not timed · last 29 s", because a copied time would be saved as if it were measured. The grind field shows
   the last shot's grind and nothing else; the app doesn't suggest a different one.
3. Adjust what changed with steppers (dose and yield in 0.1 g, time in 1 s, grind in the grinder's own step size).
   Time has two ways in, both always available: the built-in timer (Start when the pump starts, Stop when it
   stops) or typing it. "Type" opens a numeric keypad; tapping any numeral does the same for that field.
4. Pick taste (sour, balanced, bitter) and rating (1 to 5). Both start empty; they are the only new information in
   a repeat shot. A "Same as last" chip above them ("Same as last: balanced, 4") fills both in one tap when the shot
   tasted like yesterday's.
5. "Save shot". The saved screen shows the ratio, the time against the 25 to 32 s window, the taste, the shot's
   place on the dial-in target among this bag's shots, and one line comparing it with the last shot ("Inside the
   window, two seconds slower than Monday's shot"; "Ran fast at 22 s, outside the window"). It describes what
   happened and doesn't say what to change. "Undo" stays for 5 s. Undo writes a retraction record (`deleted: true`), not a delete.

Repeat shot that tasted the same: Pull again, Start, Stop, "Same as last", Save. Three taps plus the timer. If the
taste or rating differs, it's taste and rating instead of "Same as last": four taps plus the timer. Saving without
a time turns the button into "Save with 29 s?". A second tap saves the last shot's time, recorded as copied
(`time_source` = `copied`), so it never passes for a measured time and the dial-in model leaves it out.

### 3. Review a coffee

From Today or from a bag in the history list: the coffee page. Header with the bag photo, roaster and coffee name,
origin, process and tasting notes from the catalog, plus current price per 100 g, stock and a link to the roaster.
Below: best recipe so far (one whole shot: highest rating, the latest of equal ratings, as `mart_dial_in` will pick
it; see dbt changes), a ratio-and-time chart of
every shot of this coffee coloured by taste, and the shot list. Each shot opens a read-only detail with "Correct"
(writes a new record with the same `shot_id`) and "Retract".

### 4. Manage equipment

Settings → Equipment. A list of grinders, machines and baskets. Each has a name and a few fields that matter for
the steppers and, later, the dial-in model: a grinder's scale (min, max, step) and which way is finer, a basket's nominal dose. One of each is marked
default. Adding a grinder takes a name and those three numbers. Retiring one hides it from pickers but keeps old
shots pointing at it. Changes are new records, with the latest per `equipment_id` winning.
| `basket_dose_g` | double | baskets only |
| `is_default` | bool | |
| `retired` | bool | hidden from pickers, kept for history |
| `notes` | string | |

`bags/<bag_id>__<logged_at>.parquet`

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `bag_id` | string | UUID |
| `user_id` | string | |
| `logged_at` | timestamp | |
| `coffee_id` | string | null when unmatched |
| `coffee_freetext` | string | what was read or typed |
| `roast_date` | date | |
| `opened_on` | date | |
| `finished_on` | date | set by a later record when the bag is done |
| `weight_g` | int | |
| `photo_id` | string | |
| `read_json` | string | the model's raw structured output, kept for re-matching later |
| `match_score` | int | |
| `deleted` | bool | |

`photos/<photo_id>.parquet`, in the separate private photo dataset (see Privacy)

| Column | Type | Notes |
#### Sync status

Top right: a check and "Synced", or "2 waiting to sync" in `--ink-2`. It never blocks anything.

#### Undo strip

`--panel`, radius 8, no border: "Shot saved" and an accent "Undo", with a thin line under Undo
that shrinks over 5 s. Undo writes a retraction record.

#### Edit bag

An accent "Edit bag" text link (56 px tall, ending on the gutter) after the roast line on Today and on the coffee
page. The form: roaster and coffee, roast date, weight, and "Still using it" / "Finished". Saving writes a new record
under the same id (the shots stay with it) and returns to the screen it was opened from, with a notice. A roast date
in the future isn't saved; one more than 90 days old asks "Save with day N?".

#### Notice

What the last save did, at the top of the screen it lands on: "Bag saved: Onyx Geometry", "DF64 V2 saved",
"Correction saved", "Shot undone", "Password changed". `--panel`, radius 8, like the Undo strip; `role="status"`,
so it's read out (shown empty, then filled, so screen readers announce it). A save queued offline says so: "Saved on

---
Starting. Plan: one workstream, `finish-bag`. A scribe keeps the workstream doc and task JSON on a local `orchestration` branch (sandbox, so nothing is pushed). One implementer builds the Finish button and its tests on a local `finish-bag` branch. Then two separate reviewers: first spec compliance, then quality. Each one runs the tests itself. # Coffee Data. The lake is $COFFEEDATA_LAKE (default ./lake); set it to hf://datasets/<you>/<name> to publish.
SAMPLE ?=

.PHONY: install hooks fmt init weekly ingest probe discover enrich build site publish mcp app lint test clean

install:
	uv sync

init:  ## create the lake (and publish its schema files to a remote lake); make init PUBLIC=1 for a public dataset
	uv run coffeedata init $(if $(PUBLIC),--public)

weekly:  ## the full weekly run: discover (1st week), probe, ingest, enrich, build, publish, site
	uv run coffeedata weekly $(if $(SAMPLE),--sample $(SAMPLE))

ingest:  ## make ingest [SAMPLE=50]
	uv run coffeedata ingest $(if $(SAMPLE),--sample $(SAMPLE))

probe:
	uv run coffeedata probe

discover:
	uv run coffeedata discover overture
	uv run coffeedata discover osm

enrich:  ## Claude enrichment (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
	uv run coffeedata enrich

build:  ## dbt build from the lake + export marts
	uv run coffeedata build

site: build
	uv run coffeedata site

publish:
	uv run coffeedata publish

mcp:
	uv run coffeedata mcp

app:  ## the shot-logging app on http://localhost:8000, over the local lake (signed in as the owner unless SESSION_SECRET is set)
	uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host $${HOST:-127.0.0.1} --port $${PORT:-8000}

hooks:  ## install the git pre-commit hooks
	uv run pre-commit install

fmt:
	uv run ruff check --fix src app tests
	uv run ruff format src app tests

lint:  ## the same checks as the pre-commit hooks, on every file
	uv run pre-commit run --all-files

test: lint  ## offline: unit tests + dbt builds over synthetic lakes
	uv run pytest -q

clean:
	rm -rf build dbt/target dbt/logs

165	    def coffee(self, coffee_id: str | None) -> dict | None:
166	        """Catalog facts for a coffee from the weekly dim_coffee export, if there is one."""
167	        if not coffee_id:
168	            return None
169	        hit = self._coffees.get(coffee_id)
170	        if hit and (hit[0] is not None or time.monotonic() - hit[1] < MISS_TTL):
171	            return hit[0]
172	        src = ", ".join(f"'{s}'" for s in self.lake.mart_sources("dim_coffee"))
173	        try:
174	            cur = self.lake.connect().execute(
175	                f"select * from read_parquet([{src}], union_by_name = true) where coffee_id = ?",
176	                [coffee_id],
177	            )
178	            row = cur.fetchone()
179	            cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
180	            keep = set(FACTS) & set(cols)
181	            found = {k: v for k, v in zip(cols, row, strict=True) if k in keep} if row else None
182	        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - no catalog export yet, or the network
183	            log.info("no catalog facts for %s: %s", coffee_id, e)
184	            return None  # not cached: try again next time
185	        # A coffee not in this week's export is asked again after MISS_TTL, not never.
186	        self._coffees[coffee_id] = (found, time.monotonic())
187	        return found

189	    def bags_of(self, user_id: str) -> list[Bag]:
190	        """This person's bags, the one used most recently first (a bag with no shots by when it was opened)."""
191	        mine = self.shots_of(user_id)
192	        last = {s.bag_id: s.brewed_at for s in mine if s.bag_id}
193	        recs = self._mine(self.bags, user_id)
194	
195	        def when(r: Rec) -> datetime:
196	            return last.get(r.item.bag_id) or r.logged_at
197	
198	        return [r.item for r in sorted(recs, key=when, reverse=True)]

207	            if s.bag_id in bag_ids or (not s.bag_id and coffee_key(s) == key)

223	    def prefill(
224	        self,
225	        user_id: str,
226	        grinder_id: str | None = None,
227	        basket_id: str | None = None,
228	        machine_id: str | None = None,
229	        bag_id: str | None = None,
230	    ) -> dict:
231	        """What the Log shot form starts from: the last shot of the current bag, else of the same coffee.
232	        Time, taste and rating are never copied; the last ones are offered, not filled in. A grinder or basket
233	        picked from the chip replaces the last shot's; the grind then comes from this coffee's last shot on
234	        that grinder, since a setting means nothing on another grinder."""
235	        selected = self.bag(user_id, bag_id)
236	        bag = selected if selected and not selected.finished_on else self.current_bag(user_id)
237	        mine = self.shots_of(user_id)
238	        last = None
239	        if bag:
240	            same = [s for s in mine if s.bag_id == bag.bag_id] or [
241	                s for s in mine if coffee_key(s) == coffee_key(bag)
242	            ]
243	            last = same[-1] if same else None
244	        elif mine:
245	            last = mine[-1]
246	        picked = self.gear(user_id, grinder_id)
247	        grinder = (
248	            picked
249	            if picked and picked.kind == "grinder"
250	            else self.gear(user_id, last.grinder_id if last else None)
251	        )
252	        grinders = self.equipment_of(user_id, "grinder")
253	        if not grinder or grinder.retired:
254	            grinder = grinders[0] if grinders else None
255	        baskets = self.equipment_of(user_id, "basket")
256	        picked = self.gear(user_id, basket_id)
257	        basket = (
258	            picked
259	            if picked and picked.kind == "basket"
260	            else self.gear(user_id, last.basket_id if last else None)
261	        )
262	        if not basket or basket.retired:  # like the grinder: a retired basket isn't offered again
263	            basket = baskets[0] if baskets else None
264	        if grinder and last and last.grinder_id and last.grinder_id != grinder.equipment_id:
265	            # Switched grinders: this coffee's last shot on the new one, if any, gives the grind.
266	            on = [
267	                s for s in mine if s.grinder_id == grinder.equipment_id and coffee_key(s) == coffee_key(last)
268	            ]
269	            grind_from = on[-1] if on else None
270	        else:
271	            grind_from = last
272	        dose = last.dose_g if last else (basket.basket_dose_g if basket and basket.basket_dose_g else None)
273	        grind = None
274	        if grind_from and (
275	            not grind_from.grinder_id or not grinder or grind_from.grinder_id == grinder.equipment_id
276	        ):
277	            grind = grind_from.grinder_setting
278	        elif grinder and grinder.scale_min is not None and grinder.scale_max is not None:
279	            # No shot on this grinder yet: the middle of the dial, a starting point to move from, not advice.
280	            step = grinder.scale_step or 1
281	            grind = grinder.scale_min + round((grinder.scale_max - grinder.scale_min) / 2 / step) * step
282	        return {
283	            "bag": bag,
284	            "last": last,
285	            "grinder": grinder,
286	            "basket": basket,
287	            "machine": self._machine(user_id, machine_id, last),
288	            "coffee_id": bag.coffee_id if bag else last.coffee_id if last else None,
289	            "coffee_freetext": bag.coffee_freetext if bag else last.coffee_freetext if last else None,
290	            "dose_g": dose,
291	            "yield_g": last.yield_g if last else (round(dose * 2, 1) if dose else None),
292	            "grinder_setting": grind,
293	            "water_temp_c": last.water_temp_c if last else None,
294	            "brew_method": last.brew_method if last else "espresso",
295	            "is_milk_drink": bool(last and last.is_milk_drink),
296	            "last_time_s": last.time_s if last else None,
297	            "same_as_last": {"taste": last.taste, "rating": last.rating} if last else None,
298	        }

300	    def _machine(self, user_id: str, picked: str | None, last: Shot | None) -> Equipment | None:
301	        """The picked machine, else the last shot's (unless retired), else the default."""
302	        for eid in (picked, last.machine_id if last else None):
303	            e = self.gear(user_id, eid)
304	            if e and e.kind == "machine" and not e.retired:
305	                return e
306	        return next(iter(self.equipment_of(user_id, "machine")), None)

309	
310	    def _commit(self, recs: dict[str, Rec], key: str, item: Any, table: str, deleted: bool = False) -> Rec:
311	        """One lake file for one record, published before returning; the cache changes only after that.
312	
313	        The lock covers staging the file, which fixes its logged_at, not the upload, so a slow commit to Hugging
314	        Face doesn't hold up everyone else's writes. Lake.publish runs one upload at a time and sends whatever is
315	        staged, so a request's file may go up in another request's commit."""
316	        with self.lock:
317	            prev = recs.get(key)
318	            after = max((t for t in (prev and prev.logged_at, self._staged.get(key)) if t), default=None)
319	            if table == "shots":
320	                at = shots.record(item, self.lake, deleted, after=after)
321	            else:
322	                at = datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0)
323	                if after and at <= after:
324	                    at = after + timedelta(seconds=1)
325	                row = item.model_dump() | {"logged_at": at, "deleted": deleted}
326	                self.lake.write(table, f"{table}/{key}__{at:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}.parquet", [row])
327	            self._staged[key] = at  # the next record for this key sorts after this one, published or not
328	        started = time.perf_counter()
329	        self.lake.publish(f"app: {table} {key}")
330	        logs.event(
331	            "saved",
332	            table=table,
333	            id=key,
334	            deleted=deleted,
335	            publish_ms=round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000),
336	        )
337	        rec = Rec(item, at, deleted)
338	        with self.lock:
339	            current = recs.get(key)
340	            if current is None or current.logged_at <= at:  # a later record may have landed meanwhile
341	                recs[key] = rec
342	        return rec
343	
344	    def _owned(self, recs: dict[str, Rec], key: str, user_id: str) -> Rec | None:
345	        prev = recs.get(key)
346	        if prev and prev.item.user_id != user_id:
347	            raise NotFound(key)
348	        return prev

350	    def save_shot(self, user_id: str, data: dict) -> tuple[Shot, bool]:
351	        """Record a shot from the app. Returns the shot and whether a new record was written."""
352	        data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k not in ("user_id", "source")}
353	        shot = Shot(**data, user_id=user_id, source="app")
354	        shot = shot.model_copy(update={"brewed_at": shot.brewed_at.astimezone(UTC).replace(microsecond=0)})
355	        for ref, table in (
356	            (shot.grinder_id, self.equipment),
357	            (shot.basket_id, self.equipment),
358	            (shot.machine_id, self.equipment),
359	            (shot.bag_id, self.bags),
360	        ):
361	            if ref and self._owned(table, ref, user_id) is None:
362	                raise NotFound(ref)
363	        grinder = self.gear(user_id, shot.grinder_id)
364	        lo, hi = (grinder.scale_min, grinder.scale_max) if grinder else (None, None)
365	        if lo is not None and hi is not None and not lo <= shot.grinder_setting <= hi:
366	            raise Invalid(
367	                f"Grind {shot.grinder_setting:g} is outside {grinder.name if grinder else 'the grinder'}'s dial "
368	                f"({lo:g} to {hi:g})."
369	            )
370	        bag = self.bag(user_id, shot.bag_id)
371	        if shot.bag_id and bag is None:
372	            raise NotFound(shot.bag_id)
373	        prev = self._owned(self.shots, shot.shot_id, user_id)
374	        moved = prev is not None and bag is not None and prev.item.bag_id != bag.bag_id
375	        if bag and (moved or (not shot.coffee_id and not shot.coffee_freetext)):
376	            # The bag says which coffee it is; a correction that moves the shot to another bag takes that bag's.
377	            shot = shot.model_copy(
378	                update={"coffee_id": bag.coffee_id, "coffee_freetext": bag.coffee_freetext}
379	            )
380	        if prev:
381	            # A correction keeps what the Log shot form doesn't carry: where the shot came from and its roast date.
382	            shot = shot.model_copy(
383	                update={
384	                    "source": prev.item.source,
385	                    "roast_date": shot.roast_date
386	                    or (bag.roast_date if moved and bag else prev.item.roast_date),
387	                }
388	            )
389	        if prev and prev.item == shot:
390	            # A retry of a write that already landed, including one that arrives after Undo: a late resend
391	            # must not bring a retracted shot back.
392	            return shot, False
393	        if prev and prev.deleted:
394	            # Only Undo (restore_shot) brings a retracted shot back, not a correction saved in another tab.
395	            raise Invalid("That shot was retracted, so it can’t be corrected. Undo the retraction first.")
396	        self._commit(self.shots, shot.shot_id, shot, "shots")
397	        return shot, True

399	    def retract_shot(self, user_id: str, shot_id: str) -> bool:
400	        """Undo: a retraction record (deleted = true), never a delete. Retracting twice writes once."""
401	        prev = self._owned(self.shots, shot_id, user_id)
402	        if prev is None:
403	            raise NotFound(shot_id)
404	        if prev.deleted:
405	            return False
406	        self._commit(self.shots, shot_id, prev.item, "shots", deleted=True)
407	        return True
408	
409	    def restore_shot(self, user_id: str, shot_id: str) -> bool:
410	        """Undo a retraction: the shot again, as a new record. Restoring a shot that's there writes nothing."""
411	        prev = self._owned(self.shots, shot_id, user_id)
412	        if prev is None:
413	            raise NotFound(shot_id)
414	        if not prev.deleted:
415	            return False
416	        self._commit(self.shots, shot_id, prev.item, "shots")
417	        return True

419	    def save_equipment(self, user_id: str, data: dict) -> Equipment:
420	        """Add or change equipment. One default per kind: making this one the default clears the others.
421	        A change keeps what the body leaves out (notes, a model the form doesn't show, retired), so editing a
422	        grinder made elsewhere doesn't erase its notes and saving a retired one doesn't bring it back."""
423	        data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k != "user_id"}
424	        prev = self._owned(self.equipment, str(data.get("equipment_id") or ""), user_id)
425	        if prev:
426	            kept = prev.item.model_dump(exclude={"user_id"})
427	            data = {k: v for k, v in kept.items() if k not in data} | data
428	        item = Equipment(**data, user_id=user_id)
429	        if prev and prev.item.kind != item.kind:
430	            raise Invalid("Equipment can't change kind. Add a new one instead.")
431	        if item.retired:
432	            item = item.model_copy(update={"is_default": False})
433	        if not (prev and prev.item == item):
434	            self._commit(self.equipment, item.equipment_id, item, "equipment")
435	        if item.is_default:
436	            for other in self.equipment_of(user_id, item.kind):
437	                if other.equipment_id != item.equipment_id and other.is_default:
438	                    self._commit(
439	                        self.equipment,
440	                        other.equipment_id,
441	                        other.model_copy(update={"is_default": False}),
442	                        "equipment",
443	                    )
444	        return item

446	    def save_bag(self, user_id: str, data: dict) -> tuple[Bag, list[dict]]:
447	        """A bag typed by hand: matched to the catalog the same way a typed shot is."""
448	        bag = Bag(**{k: v for k, v in data.items() if k != "user_id"}, user_id=user_id)
449	        prev = self._owned(self.bags, bag.bag_id, user_id)
450	        # Today in UTC plus a day's grace (the phone checks the same), so no zone's "today" is refused. Only a date
451	        # being set now is refused, so a bag stored before this check (with a future date) can still take its photo's
452	        # match.
453	        new_date = not (prev and prev.item.roast_date == bag.roast_date)
454	        if new_date and bag.roast_date and bag.roast_date > datetime.now(UTC).date() + timedelta(days=1):
455	            raise Invalid("That roast date is in the future. Check the year.")
456	        same_text = prev and (prev.item.coffee_freetext or "").strip() == (bag.coffee_freetext or "").strip()
457	        if prev and same_text and not bag.coffee_id:
458	            # A resend or an edit of something else keeps the match; changed text is matched again below.
459	            bag = bag.model_copy(
460	                update={"coffee_id": prev.item.coffee_id, "match_score": prev.item.match_score}
461	            )
462	        matches: list[dict] = []
463	        if not bag.coffee_id and bag.coffee_freetext:
464	            coffee_id, matches = shots.match_coffee(bag.coffee_freetext, self.lake)
465	            score = matches[0]["score"] if coffee_id else None
466	            bag = bag.model_copy(update={"coffee_id": coffee_id, "match_score": score})
467	        opened = bag.opened_on or (prev.item.opened_on if prev else None) or date.today()
468	        bag = bag.model_copy(update={"opened_on": opened})
469	        if not (prev and prev.item == bag):
470	            self._commit(self.bags, bag.bag_id, bag, "bags")
471	        return bag, matches

504	def g(x: float | None, digits: int | None = None) -> str:
505	    if x is None:
506	        return ""

519	    if s.time_s < TARGET_TIME[0]:

524	def _seconds(n: int) -> str:
525	    word = _WORDS[n] if n < 10 else str(n)

529	def _when(prev: Shot, now: Shot, tz: tzinfo) -> str:
530	    a, b = prev.brewed_at.astimezone(tz), now.brewed_at.astimezone(tz)
531	    if a.date() == b.date():
532	        return "the last shot"
533	    if (b.date() - a.date()).days < 7:
534	        return f"{a:%A}’s shot"
535	    return f"the {a:%b} {a.day} shot"

538	def summary(s: Shot, prev: Shot | None, tz: tzinfo) -> str:
539	    """'Inside the window, two seconds slower than Monday’s shot.' What happened, not what to change."""
540	    w = window(s)
541	    out = "Inside the window" if w == "in" else f"Ran {w} at {g(s.time_s)} s, outside the window"
542	    if prev:
543	        d = round(s.time_s - prev.time_s)
544	        when = _when(prev, s, tz)
545	        if d == 0:
546	            out += f", the same time as {when}"
547	        elif w == "in":
548	            out += f", {_seconds(abs(d))} {'slower' if d > 0 else 'faster'} than {when}"
549	        else:
550	            out += f"; {when} was {g(prev.time_s)} s"
551	    return out + "."

560	def target_svg(shots: list[Shot], height: int = 150, label: str = "", sequence: bool = True) -> str:
561	    """Time across, ratio up, and the 25–32 s, 1:1.8–2.3 window shaded. The axes expand to include all shown
562	    shots, numbered in order and joined oldest to newest, the newest ringed. With `sequence=False` (a coffee's page,
563	    many shots across bags) the marks are plain: neither numbered nor joined."""
564	    left, right, top, bottom = 32, 350, 8, height - 24
565	    shown = shots[-8:] if sequence else shots
566	    times = [s.time_s for s in shown]
567	    ratios = [ratio(s) for s in shown]
568	    tmin = max(0.0, min(18.0, min(times, default=18.0) - 2)) if times and min(times) < 18 else 18.0
569	    tmax = max(38.0, max(times, default=38.0) + 2) if times and max(times) > 38 else 38.0
570	    rmin = max(0.0, min(1.6, min(ratios) - 0.1)) if ratios and min(ratios) < 1.6 else 1.6
571	    rmax = max(2.5, max(ratios) + 0.1) if ratios and max(ratios) > 2.5 else 2.5
572	
573	    def x(t: float) -> float:
574	        return left + (t - tmin) / (tmax - tmin) * (right - left)
575	
576	    def y(r: float) -> float:
577	        return top + (rmax - r) / (rmax - rmin) * (bottom - top)
578	
579	    aria = label or "Shots by time and ratio against the 25 to 32 second, 1:1.8 to 1:2.3 window"
580	    out = [f'<svg class="target" viewBox="0 0 358 {height}" role="img" aria-label="{escape(aria)}">']
581	    for t in (20, 25, 30, 35) if (tmin, tmax) == (18, 38) else _ticks(tmin, tmax):
582	        out.append(
583	            f'<line class="tick" x1="{x(t):.1f}" x2="{x(t):.1f}" y1="{top}" y2="{bottom}"/>'
584	            f'<text x="{x(t):.1f}" y="{height - 6}" text-anchor="middle">{g(t)} s</text>'
585	        )
586	    default_ratio = (rmin, rmax) == (1.6, 2.5)
587	    for r in (1.8, 2.0, 2.2, 2.4) if default_ratio else _ticks(rmin, rmax):

662	def label_box(tx: float, ty: float, anchor: str) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
663	    """The box the window's label covers, from its text position and anchor."""

668	def _label_spot(
669	    win: tuple[float, float, float, float],
670	    plot: tuple[float, float, float, float],
671	    pts: list[tuple[float, float, Shot]],
672	    joined: bool,
673	    numbers: list[tuple[float, float, float, float]],
674	) -> tuple[float, float, str] | None:
675	    """Where the window's label goes: inside the box's lower-right corner when the box is tall enough, else just
676	    outside it (above, below, right, left), in the first spot clear of every mark, the newest shot's ring, the path
677	    and the order numbers. None when no spot is clear; the label is then left out."""
678	    wx0, wy0, wx1, wy1 = win
679	    spots = [(wx1 - 6, wy1 - 6, "end")] if wy1 - wy0 >= 24 else []
680	    spots += [
681	        (wx1, wy0 - 4, "end"),
682	        (wx1, wy1 + 13, "end"),
683	        (wx1 + 6, (wy0 + wy1) / 2 + 4, "start"),
684	        (wx0 - 6, (wy0 + wy1) / 2 + 4, "end"),
685	    ]
686	    segs = list(zip(pts, pts[1:], strict=False)) if joined else []
687	    for tx, ty, anchor in spots:
688	        box = label_box(tx, ty, anchor)
689	        if box[0] < plot[0] or box[2] > plot[2] or box[1] < plot[1] - 4 or box[3] > plot[3]:
690	            continue
691	        if any(_gap(box, (px, py, px, py)) < 7 for px, py, _ in pts):
692	            continue
693	        if joined and pts and _gap(box, (pts[-1][0], pts[-1][1]) * 2) < 12:
694	            continue
695	        if any(_gap(box, n) < 2 for n in numbers):
696	            continue
697	        if any(_seg_gap(box, a[:2], b[:2]) < 3 for a, b in segs):
698	            continue
699	        return tx, ty, anchor
700	    return None

703	def _seg_gap(box: tuple[float, float, float, float], a: tuple[float, float], b: tuple[float, float]) -> float:
704	    """The distance between a box and the line segment a-b, sampled every pixel or so."""
705	    n = max(1, ceil(max(abs(b[0] - a[0]), abs(b[1] - a[1]))))
706	    return min(
707	        _gap(box, (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n) * 2) for k in range(n + 1)
708	    )

711	def _ticks(low: float, high: float) -> list[float]:
712	    """At most five readable grid labels, with round steps, on an expanded axis."""
713	    raw = (high - low) / 4
714	    magnitude = 10 ** floor(log10(raw))
715	    step = next(n * magnitude for n in (1, 2, 5, 10) if n * magnitude >= raw)
716	    return [round(i * step, 6) for i in range(ceil(low / step), floor(high / step) + 1)]
717

719	def _gap(a: tuple[float, float, float, float], b: tuple[float, float, float, float]) -> float:
720	    """The distance between two boxes (0 when they touch or overlap)."""
721	    dx = max(b[0] - a[2], a[0] - b[2], 0.0)
722	    dy = max(b[1] - a[3], a[1] - b[3], 0.0)
723	    return float((dx * dx + dy * dy) ** 0.5)

137	    def same_origin(request: Request, x_requested_with: str | None) -> None:
138	        """CSRF: a cross-site form can't set X-Requested-With, and the browser says where a request came from.
139	        On top of SameSite=Lax cookies."""
140	        if not x_requested_with:
141	            raise HTTPException(403, "missing X-Requested-With")
142	        if request.headers.get("sec-fetch-site") not in (None, "same-origin", "none"):
143	            raise HTTPException(403, "cross-site request")
144	        origin = request.headers.get("origin")
145	        if origin and urlsplit(origin).netloc != request.headers.get("host"):
146	            raise HTTPException(403, "cross-site request")

148	    def writer(request: Request, x_requested_with: Annotated[str | None, Header()] = None) -> User:
149	        same_origin(request, x_requested_with)

content.content:
Role or state after a name, in 13 px `--ink-2` with no border: "jtouley owner", "Invite from Oct
24 not used yet".

#### List link

A 56-tall row with a hairline below, 17 px ink text and an ink-2 chevron when it opens something.
Actions that happen in place (Sign out) have no chevron. Destructive ones are `--danger`, have no chevron, and give
a 5 s undo strip instead of a confirmation dialog.

#### Spec sheet

Two columns, label 112 px wide in `--ink-2` and value, hairline between rows. For the match card,
catalog facts and nothing else.

#### Text input

56 tall, 17 px text, `--sheet` background, `--control` border, 8 radius. The label sits above it and
stays; hints and errors sit below in 13 px, errors in `--danger`. Focus: accent border plus a 3 px accent ring at
22%. Password fields have a 48-wide "Show" button inside. `autocomplete` is `username`, `current-password` or
`new-password`, so Android's password manager fills and saves them. Errors never clear what was typed.

#### Bag photo

6 radius with a 1 px inner outline so a pale bag doesn't melt into the paper. Dimmed slightly in dark
mode. In the mockups it's a hatched placeholder.

#### Dock

The bottom area holding the primary button and at most one text button under it. Paper (or sheet)
background, a 20 px fade above it where content scrolls under, safe-area padding below, no hairline.

#### Navigation

Three text tabs, Today, Coffees and Setup. The active one is ink, weight 600, with the accent dot
above it; the others are `--ink-2`. A 20 px fade above, no hairline. Sign in, Sign up and the camera have no tabs.

#### Sync status

Top right: a check and "Synced", or "2 waiting to sync" in `--ink-2`. It never blocks anything.

#### Undo strip

`--panel`, radius 8, no border: "Shot saved" and an accent "Undo", with a thin line under Undo
that shrinks over 5 s. Undo writes a retraction record.

#### Edit bag

An accent "Edit bag" text link (56 px tall, ending on the gutter) after the roast line on Today and on the coffee
page. The form: roaster and coffee, roast date, weight, and "Still using it" / "Finished". Saving writes a new record
under the same id (the shots stay with it) and returns to the screen it was opened from, with a notice. A roast date
in the future isn't saved; one more than 90 days old asks "Save with day N?".

#### Notice

What the last save did, at the top of the screen it lands on: "Bag saved: Onyx Geometry", "DF64 V2 saved",
"Correction saved", "Shot undone", "Password changed". `--panel`, radius 8, like the Undo strip; `role="status"`,
so it's read out (shown empty, then filled, so screen readers announce it). A save queued offline says so: "Saved on
this phone. It’ll sync when you’re back online."; a bag names itself, since Today may still show the last one until
it syncs: "Bag saved on this phone: Onyx Geometry. It’ll sync when you’re back online." Logging a shot keeps Saved as its confirmation, with Undo.

Every save leaves its form: it returns to the screen the form was opened from (Setup, first run, the gear picker
on Log shot), stepping back in history, or else replaces the form, so Back never reopens what was just saved.

## Copy

Short, plain and specific, in sentence case, with real apostrophes (’). Buttons start with a verb. The same action
has the same words everywhere ("Type the coffee", never "Type it instead"). The app says what happened and leaves

### 3. Review a coffee

From Today or from a bag in the history list: the coffee page. Header with the bag photo, roaster and coffee name,
origin, process and tasting notes from the catalog, plus current price per 100 g, stock and a link to the roaster.
Below: best recipe so far (one whole shot: highest rating, the latest of equal ratings, as `mart_dial_in` will pick
it; see dbt changes), a ratio-and-time chart of
every shot of this coffee coloured by taste, and the shot list. Each shot opens a read-only detail with "Correct"
(writes a new record with the same `shot_id`) and "Retract".

### 4. Manage equipment

Settings → Equipment. A list of grinders, machines and baskets. Each has a name and a few fields that matter for
the steppers and, later, the dial-in model: a grinder's scale (min, max, step) and which way is finer, a basket's nominal dose. One of each is marked
default. Adding a grinder takes a name and those three numbers. Retiring one hides it from pickers but keeps old
shots pointing at it. Changes are new records, with the latest per `equipment_id` winning.

def test_finish_on_the_bag_page_writes_a_new_record_and_leaves_today_and_the_pickers(client, lake):
    store = client.app.state.store
    client.post("/api/shots", json=shot(1), headers=W)
    client.post("/api/bags", json={"bag_id": "bag2", "coffee_freetext": "Other coffee"}, headers=W)
    client.post("/api/shots", json=shot(2, bag_id="bag2"), headers=W)
    client.get("/bag/bag1/use")
    page = client.get("/coffee/bag1").text
    assert 'data-finish-bag="bag1"' in page and ">Finish bag</button>" in page
    assert '<a href="/coffee/bag1">' in client.get("/").text  # on the grinder

    before = {p.name for p in files(lake, "bags")}
    r = client.post("/api/bags/bag1/finish", json={"finished_on": "2026-10-30"}, headers=W)
    assert r.json() == {"bag_id": "bag1", "written": True}
    after = {p.name for p in files(lake, "bags")}
    assert before < after and len(after - before) == 1  # one new record; the old ones are all still there
    rows = lake.connect().execute(
        f"select bag_id, finished_on, deleted from read_parquet('{lake.root}/bags/{(after - before).pop()}')"
    ).fetchall()
    assert [(b, str(f), d) for b, f, d in rows] == [("bag1", "2026-10-30", False)]  # finished, not deleted
    bag = store.bag("owner", "bag1")
    assert (bag.coffee_freetext, str(bag.roast_date), str(bag.finished_on)) == (
        "Onyx Geometry",
        "2026-10-18",
        "2026-10-30",
    )
    # Finishing again (an outbox resend) writes nothing and keeps the first date.
    again = client.post("/api/bags/bag1/finish", json={"finished_on": "2026-10-31"}, headers=W)
    assert again.json()["written"] is False and {p.name for p in files(lake, "bags")} == after
    assert str(store.bag("owner", "bag1").finished_on) == "2026-10-30"

    # Today moves to the open bag, even with the finished one still in the selected_bag cookie.
    today = client.get("/").text
    assert '<a href="/coffee/bag1">' not in today and '<a href="/coffee/bag2">' in today
    assert "/bag/bag1/edit" not in today and "Switch coffee" not in today  # one open bag left
    # The bag pickers on Log shot don't offer it: the open-bag switch, and the bag rows when correcting a shot.
    assert prefill(client)["bag_id"] == "bag2"
    assert "/bag/bag1/use" not in client.get("/bags/switch").text
    assert client.get("/bag/bag1/use").status_code == 404
    assert "bag=bag1" not in client.get("/log?correct=s2").text
    # Coffees still lists it, finished, with its shot; its page still opens, without the button.
    coffees = client.get("/coffees").text
    assert 'href="/coffee/bag1"' in coffees and "1 shot · best rated 4" in coffees and " · finished" in coffees
    page = client.get("/coffee/bag1").text
    assert "Roasted Oct 18 · day 12 · finished Oct 30" in page and "/shot/s1" in page
    assert "data-finish-bag" not in page
    # Its shots are kept, and correcting one still shows its own (finished) bag.
    assert [s.shot_id for s in store.bag_shots("owner", bag, None)] == ["s1"]
    assert 'href="/log?correct=s1&bag=bag1" aria-current="true"' in client.get("/log?correct=s1").text

    # After a restart it's read back from the lake still finished.
    assert create_app(lake, HeaderAuth()).state.store.current_bag("owner").bag_id == "bag2"

def test_finish_is_refused_for_someone_elses_or_a_missing_bag_and_for_a_future_date(client, lake):
    before = len(files(lake, "bags"))
    bob = W | {"x-test-user": "bob", "X-Expected-User": "bob"}
    assert client.post("/api/bags/bag1/finish", json={}, headers=bob).status_code == 404

    future = (datetime.now(UTC).date() + timedelta(days=3)).isoformat()

summary:
I added a "Finish bag" button to the bag page. It writes a new record with the finish date, deletes nothing, and the bag leaves Today and the bag pickers but stays in Coffees. The lint hooks and the app tests pass. The full suite was last run before my second commit: 642 passed and 1 failed, the browser test. I fixed that test's assertion afterwards and it has passed three times on its own since, but I didn't rerun the whole suite.

One thing first: **the app could already finish a bag.** Edit bag has a "Still using it" / "Finished" toggle, and Today, Switch coffee and the Log shot correction picker already left finished bags out. What was missing is a one-tap button on the bag page, so most of the change is that button plus tests for the whole behaviour.

**Commits** (local branch `finish-bag` from 6bda240, worktree `/tmp/co-r3/clones/build-finish-bag-screen-with_skill-2-finish`, not pushed):
- `e010f37` Finish a bag from its page
- `319658b` Browser test: check the finish record, not the bag's record count

**Which screen is "the bag page":** the coffee page, `/coffee/<bag_id>`. It's the one page per bag: it shows that bag's photo, roast line and shots, and Coffees and Today link to it. The docs call it "the coffee page" and say it's opened "from a bag". Edit bag is a form that already had Finished, and `bag.html` is the New bag screen, so neither fits.

**What it does:**
- **Button:** "Finish bag" appears only while the bag is still in use. Tapping it posts `/api/bags/<id>/finish` through the phone's outbox, with the phone's date.
- **Record:** the server writes the bag again with `finished_on` set, the same new-record pattern as retract. Finishing twice writes once and keeps the first date. Someone else's bag or a missing one gets a 404; a future or malformed date gets a 422.
- **After tapping:** the page reloads showing "Finished <date>" and the notice "Bag finished: <name>". Offline, it says the finish will sync later. Once it syncs, the phone forgets the bag as the one on the grinder.
- **Edits:** the store, API, coffee page template, app script, and one paragraph in `docs/app/DESIGN.md`. Tests are in `tests/test_app.py`, `tests/browser/app_flow.js` and `tests/test_app_browser.py`.

**Test commands and raw summary lines** (run in the worktree):
- `uv run pytest -q tests/test_app.py tests/test_bags.py tests/test_m1_fixes.py tests/test_m3_fixes.py tests/test_m4_fixes.py tests/test_app_browser.py` on unchanged main: `119 passed, 1 skipped, 1 warning in 39.79s` (the browser test skipped because Playwright wasn't installed).
- `npm ci` in `tests/browser` made the browser test runnable.
- `uv run pytest -q tests/test_app.py -k "finish"`: `4 passed, 42 deselected in 2.63s`
- `uv run pre-commit run --all-files`: the first run reformatted files (ruff format "Failed"). Every run after that showed all hooks Passed, including ruff, ruff format and mypy.
- `uv run pytest -q`, full suite after the first commit: `1 failed, 642 passed, 2 skipped, 1 warning in 1206.02s (0:20:06)`. The failure was my own new browser-test assertion, `assert 3 == 2` on the number of record files for one bag. An earlier full run was stopped at the 10-minute background limit.
- `uv run pytest -q tests/test_app_browser.py` with the fixed assertion: `1 passed in 77.96s (0:01:17)`, `1 passed in 77.72s (0:01:17)`, and once more with `-s` and a temporary print: `1 passed in 73.89s (0:01:13)`.

**Left out, skipped or not verified:**
- **Full suite not rerun** after `319658b` (about 20 minutes on this busy machine). Only the browser test was rerun.
- **Extra record not explained.** In the failing run, the bag the browser test finishes had three records instead of two. Normal runs show two: the bag, then one finish. My guess is an earlier, unchanged step that sends that bag from two tabs at once, but I didn't prove it. The fixed assertion checks that exactly one record, the last, is finished and none is deleted, so a doubled finish record would still fail it.
- **Existing gaps, untouched:**
  - Two finish requests landing at the same moment could both write. Retract has the same pattern.
  - An older Edit bag save still waiting in the outbox (with "Still using it") could undo a later finish. That's the known missing `rev` counter in the plan.
- **Finishing the only bag:** Today then shows the last shot's coffee as "Last coffee", with no link to the bag and no Edit bag link. Log shot then goes to New bag. That's existing behaviour; I tested it but didn't change it.
- **Correcting an old shot:** the Log shot picker still lists a finished bag when it's that shot's own bag. This was there before and I kept it; it's covered by a test.
- **Not added:** an un-finish button or an Undo strip. Edit bag's "Still using it" already takes a bag back, and a test covers that.
- **Wording:** the button says "Finish bag" rather than just "Finish", because the repo's style is that buttons say what they act on.

Role or state after a name, in 13 px `--ink-2` with no border: "jtouley owner", "Invite from Oct
24 not used yet".

#### List link

A 56-tall row with a hairline below, 17 px ink text and an ink-2 chevron when it opens something.
Actions that happen in place (Sign out) have no chevron. Destructive ones are `--danger`, have no chevron, and give
a 5 s undo strip instead of a confirmation dialog.

#### Spec sheet

Two columns, label 112 px wide in `--ink-2` and value, hairline between rows. For the match card,
catalog facts and nothing else.

#### Text input

56 tall, 17 px text, `--sheet` background, `--control` border, 8 radius. The label sits above it and

22%. Password fields have a 48-wide "Show" button inside. `autocomplete` is `username`, `current-password` or
`new-password`, so Android's password manager fills and saves them. Errors never clear what was typed.

Top right: a check and "Synced", or "2 waiting to sync" in `--ink-2`. It never blocks anything.

#### Undo strip

`--panel`, radius 8, no border: "Shot saved" and an accent "Undo", with a thin line under Undo
that shrinks over 5 s. Undo writes a retraction record.

#### Edit bag

An accent "Edit bag" text link (56 px tall, ending on the gutter) after the roast line on Today and on the coffee

   the owner can see how close they are. Tapping a row picks it. "None of these: type the coffee" opens search; if

   `coffee_freetext` works today.
8. If the roast date couldn't be read, a date picker defaults to 7 days ago.

Two taps when the match is confident, three when it's weak. The bag becomes the "current bag" until another one is started or it's marked
